msg: Hi , Your goal is to get as many as mushrooms as possible. The gnomes will show up in four fixed pairs->  green and pink, brown and orange, blue and purple, red and yellow.The orange, green, blue and red gromes take you to the bright forest and the pink,brown,purple and yellow gromes take you to the dark forest. Try to remember which forest has more mushrooms so you know which grome to pick .Also, the number of mushrooms in each forest can change. Finally , good luck !
